project.title: Shep
project.description: Shep is an UTAU Vocal Synth I made with a friend. I voice him while my friend illustrated and configured him. We both worked on his character profile together.

project.title: Flasher n' Creeper
project.description: Peeper n' Creeper is a visual novel concept in the making. Written by myself and a friend with illustrations in progress. It is meant to be a quick one-shot visual novel made in the game creation program Ren'py.

project.title: Filipino WikiFur Articles
project.description: Filipino WikiFur Articles are a series of articles on WikiFur related to Filipino Furry Conventions. Started by another member of the wiki a few years ago, I spent the majority of 2024 and 2025 revamping the articles to modern Wiki standards and updating listed information. I am often regarded as "The Wiki Editor" in filipino furry communities as a result.
